title: Beet Pasta Sauce
summary: Made with wholesome ingredients, this beet pasta sauce is quick to prepare and perfect for all ages! Whether you're introducing new flavors to your baby or adding a nutritious boost to family meals, t…
ingredients: 170g of roughly chopped steamed or roasted and peeled beets, about 1 1/2 medium beets
basil, a handful (doesn't have to be exact)
1/3 cup (3 oz or 80g) whole milk ricotta
steps: In a food processor or blender, add all the ingredients minus the oil and pulse several times.
Leaving the food processor running, slowly add the olive oil until all ingredients are well combined. If pesto is too thick, add extra oil or water.
Store in a jar for up to a week or freeze for up to 3 months (recommend freezing in single-serve portions)
